tools.name: diogenes_discover_tools
tools.description: Search 107 deterministic edge microservices across 8 domain suites (gemini-suite, web3-security, agent-guardrails, dev-utilities, neural-search-engine, data-pipeline, crypto-market, code-execution). Returns matching tool names, 1-line summaries, satoshi/USDC prices, and free-tier flags.

tools.name: diogenes_inspect_tool
tools.description: Retrieve full JSON Schema definitions, input parameters, and usage instructions for up to 5 Diogenes tools. Call this after discovering tools to inspect exact parameter types before execution.
